card.line: Haran was a city in Mesopotamia where Terah's family settled and Terah died, and from which Abram set out for Canaan, the land God promised him.

moments.title: Terah settles and dies
moments.text: Terah took Abram, Sarai, and Lot toward Canaan, but they stopped and settled in Haran. Terah lived 205 years and died there.

moments.title: Abram leaves Haran
moments.text: Abram departed as the LORD had directed him. He was seventy-five years old when he left Haran with Sarai, Lot, and all the possessions and people they had acquired there, and they set out for Canaan.
